records.name: 关键词三维关系网
records.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Mobile-only Chinese knowledge reader in the established warm paper-atlas style, ink serif headings, restrained sage/ochre accents, fine lines, comfortable phone text. No device frame, OS chrome, engineering IDs, mastery scores, invented educational facts or new categories. The user specifically rejected sphere-led graphs and too many schema-field headings. User-facing labels must NOT include 先修 or prerequisite. Internal graph data stays the same; use natural language “理解它的基础”, “以它为基础”, “其他关联”.
Create a revised mobile FULLSCREEN 3D relationship explorer. WORDS are the graph nodes and the visual subject. Absolutely NO large spheres, balls, or enclosing circular badges, no giant node cards. Render these SIX concept names as readable ink text floating in a subtle spatial perspective, facing the reader: 大语言模型 (current focus), 模型, 下一个词预测与自回归生成 (wrap cleanly), 微调与指令微调, 预训练, 人工智能生成内容. Emphasize current text gently. Convey depth through perspective of fine connectors, placement and subtle typographic shadows, not big decorative objects or blurred unreadable words.
Only these connections: 模型→大语言模型; 下一个词预测与自回归生成→大语言模型; 大语言模型→微调与指令微调; 预训练—大语言模型 and 人工智能生成内容—大语言模型 without arrows. Show a small contextual sentence at the selected 模型 connection: “模型是理解大语言模型的基础”. Don't use 先修.
Header 返回正文 / 关系网 / search; 全图/当前概念 toggle; compact 定位/暂停/操作提示 controls. The canvas occupies the upper/main reading space, no mountains or spherical ornaments.
A modest bottom expandable panel titled 相邻概念 · 41个 shows MULTIPLE real neighbors, not one: compact grouped rows “理解它的基础 · 2” with 模型 and 下一个词预测与自回归生成; “以它为基础 · 1” with 微调与指令微调; “其他关联 · 38” with 预训练、人工智能生成内容、提示与提示工程 as a visible sample. A clear 查看全部41个 action expands the complete scrollable list. This sheet must not cover most of the keyword canvas; use concise row text, no giant icons. Give 阅读正文 access for current concept. This static graph is a sample of five neighbors, not a claim that only five of 41 exist. No fixed learning route implied.
